faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for PAU Jr. Field / Lab Helper Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the application form for the Jr. Field / Lab Helper post at Punjab Agricultural University is 12 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in PAU Jr. Field / Lab Helper Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the Jr. Field / Lab Helper post in the Punjab Agricultural University Recruitment 2026. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for PAU Jr. Field / Lab Helper posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Jr. Field / Lab Helper posts at Punjab Agricultural University is offline. Candidates need to download, fill, and send the application form by post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for PAU Jr. Field / Lab Helper Recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Jr. Field / Lab Helper post should be between 18 and 63 years of age. Age relaxation details, if any, will be in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Jr. Field / Lab Helper at PAU?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Jr. Field / Lab Helper post at PAU will receive a salary of Rs. 13486 + 800 per month. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for PAU Jr. Field / Lab Helper?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Jr. Field / Lab Helper post involves appearing before a Selection Committee. Candidates should check the official notification for specific details.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for PAU Jr. Field / Lab Helper Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee for all categories, including General/OBC and SC/ST, is Rs. 100. This fee must be paid as per the instructions in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for PAU Jr. Field / Lab Helper Recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification for PAU Jr. Field / Lab Helper Recruitment 2026 can be downloaded from the official website of Punjab Agricultural University, pau.edu.

faq.answer: The official website for Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) is https://pau.edu. All official updates and application forms will be available on this portal.

faq.answer: Candidates who have applied for the Jr. Field / Lab Helper post will need to appear before the Selection Committee on 24 August 2026. Further details will be communicated.
